title: $37,944 grant supports AI-guided CMPSC 132 assignment transformation
body: Penn State’s AI Center of Excellence for Teaching and Learning awarded a $37,944 Large Course Transformation Grant for “Making Data-Structure Reasoning Visible: AI-Guided Assignment Transformation for CMPSC 132 Across Penn State Campuses.” Suman Saha serves as principal investigator, working with Mahfuza Farooque, Krishna Kambhampaty, Xianfang Tan, and Griselda Conejo Lopez. The award supports the project from July 2026 through June 2027.
